units.context: Scenario: Diplomatic and Culturally Sensitive Negotiation · Lesson: Opening with Tact · dialogue line 0
units.source: First, we deeply value the friendship built through our many years of cooperation.
units.translation: En primer lugar, valoramos profundamente la amistad construida durante nuestros muchos años de cooperación.

units.context: Scenario: Diplomatic and Culturally Sensitive Negotiation · Lesson: Opening with Tact · dialogue line 1
units.source: So do we, this relationship means a great deal to us.
units.translation: Nosotros también; esta relación es de gran importancia para nosotros.

units.source: Um, precisely because of this, we hope to discuss this disagreement with a candid attitude.

units.context: Scenario: Diplomatic and Culturally Sensitive Negotiation · Lesson: Opening with Tact · dialogue line 5
units.source: Thank you, that genuinely puts us at ease.
units.translation: Gracias, eso realmente nos tranquiliza.

units.source: We believe this discussion will ultimately achieve mutual benefit for both sides.
units.translation: Creemos que este debate terminará por generar beneficios para ambas partes.

units.context: Scenario: Diplomatic and Culturally Sensitive Negotiation · Lesson: Opening with Tact · dialogue line 7
units.source: We're also looking forward to that kind of outcome.
units.translation: También esperamos ese tipo de resultado.

units.source: Then let's begin today's agenda.
units.translation: Entonces, comencemos con la agenda de hoy.

units.source: "或许我们可以换一个角度来看这个问题" ("perhaps we could look at this from a different angle") indirectly signals disagreement while inviting the other side to reconsider, rather than rejecting their position outright.
